JOYSTAR Manteca 20" Girls' Cruiser Bike
Capture the essence of summer with the JOYSTAR Manteca Girls' Bike. Featuring a timeless vintage cruiser silhouette, a plush banana seat, and high-rise handlebars, this bike is designed for stylish young riders aged 7 and up who want comfort and flair in equal measure.

Classic beach cruiser style: The JOYSTAR Manteca in Vintage Pink.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Engineered for smooth cruising, the Manteca combines a low-step frame for easy mounting with a dependable dual-brake system for total peace of mind."
Safety First, Style Always
The JOYSTAR Manteca is built with a reinforced HI-TEN steel cruiser frame that provides a stable, upright riding position. Safety is paramount, which is why we've equipped it with a dual-braking system: a traditional rear coaster brake for intuitive stopping and a front caliper hand brake to help riders develop advanced braking skills.

Maximum control with front hand brake and rear coaster brake.

Key Features & Benefits

Iconic Comfort: The elongated, padded banana seat and high-rise "Ape" handlebars ensure a relaxed, ergonomic ride for blocks on end.

Smooth Rolling: 2.125" wide pneumatic white-wall tires offer superior shock absorption and a smooth glide on various surfaces.

Built to Last: Featuring a heavy-duty steel frame and high-quality paint finish that resists chips and scratches during play.

Full Protection: A color-matched full chain guard protects legs and clothing from grease and moving parts.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Spend less time in the garage and more time on the road. The JOYSTAR Manteca arrives 85% pre-assembled. With the included tools and step-by-step guide, you can have her new favorite bike ready to ride in approximately 20 minutes.

Easy Setup: Follow our assembly guide to get rolling in no time.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

See It In Action

Watch: The Manteca offers a smooth, confident ride for every neighborhood adventure.

Our Guarantee
JOYSTAR stands by every bike we build. Enjoy the following protections with your purchase:

Lifetime Frame Warranty: Our steel frames are guaranteed for the life of the original owner.

2-Year Component Coverage: Non-wear parts are protected against manufacturing defects for two years.

Customer Support: Access to our dedicated support team for assembly help or replacement parts.
